  \draw[purple] (-0.5,0.6) rectangle (5,-3.5);

  \node[anchor=base west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (0,-0.6) {$r$};

  \node[anchor=base west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (0,-1.2) {$\sin x$};
  \node[anchor=base west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (2,-1.2) {$x+y$};
  \node[font=\footnotesize,anchor=base west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (0,-1.8) {$x$};
